about: SJ Injury Attorneys is a personal injury firm with a single office in Pasadena.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile; Secretary of State registration still to confirm

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 1 named attorney published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 177 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2020-05-01, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the results page served 2291 characters of text and no figure or mention of a settlement, verdict or recovery, so there was nothing on it to count. Whether the results are held back from the served HTML or the page carries none is not something this check can tell.

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2) and do not count against the firm. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar B in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
